verdict.rationale: The pack documents real-time multiplayer editing and a capable editor. It never says which of these are on a free plan, or whether collaboration works without a paid seat. The only pricing excerpt lists features such as code exports, version history and Team Library with no tier attribution, so free-tier delivery is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a designer, the free tier supports real design work — usable editor and collaboration without a paid seat
